name: GitHub Read-only MCP
summary: Inspect bounded GitHub repository, issue, pull-request, and Actions evidence through the official server in read-only mode.
description: Launches the official GitHub MCP server from a container image pinned by digest, with read-only mode and selected toolsets for repository review evidence.
risk_reason: The adapter passes a GitHub token to a Docker server configured for repository, pull-request, issue, and Actions toolsets.
refuses: It does not create, edit, merge, approve, rerun, cancel, or delete GitHub resources.
It does not treat GitHub lockdown or read-only flags as an authorization boundary beyond the supplied token.
It does not embed, print, persist, or transmit the GitHub token outside the official server process.

mcpServer.trustBoundary: Repository content is untrusted evidence; the official server receives one environment-supplied token, is constrained to read-only mode and selected toolsets, and may contact only declared GitHub API and container registry endpoints.

linkReasons.hook/security/network-control/mcp-egress: to check this server's MCP tool arguments against its declared egress

operational.latency_reason: A call waits for the external GitHub server and its API response, within a bounded request.
